title: The Man Who Lost His 'Self' — And Became a Living Ghost
hook: A rare neurological condition erased his sense of identity. He can see his reflection, but he doesn't believe it's him.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea of losing your 'self' is deeply unsettling and existentially terrifying. Viewers will feel compelled to learn how the brain creates identity.
